title: Run TF integration tests (prepare)
description: Prepare to run Maven integration profile `with-tensorflow`; ensure a TensorFlow SavedModel or .tflite path and confirm TF native libraries are available on the machine.

title: Execute TF integration tests
description: Attempted to run `mvn -Pwith-tensorflow -Dcodetalker.model.path=<SAVED_MODEL_PATH> verify` using local `universal-sentence-encoder-lite.tflite` in `src/main/resources/models`; Maven failed due to PowerShell argument parsing error. Capture diagnostic output and prepare re-run.

title: Collect integration artifacts and update docs
description: If integration tests pass, summarize results and update POM/docs with TF notes and model path.

title: Retry TF integration with correct quoting and native checks
description: Re-run Maven with a PowerShell-safe quoted `-Dcodetalker.model.path` and, if the run starts, watch for native TensorFlow/TFLite errors (UnsatisfiedLinkError).

title: Download HF model all-MiniLM-L6-v2
description: Use `huggingface_hub.snapshot_download` to download `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` into `src/main/resources/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`. Honor `HF_TOKEN` if set in the environment.

title: Mirror todo rule enforcement
description: Ensure that when the assistant adds/updates the internal `manage_todo_list`, it immediately writes the same changes to `ironhat_TODO.md` per project rule.

title: Move runtime-essential files to flat model path
description: Copy config/tokenizer/model files from the HF snapshot into `src/main/resources/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/` for predictable Java/REST loading.

title: Add Python FastAPI shim (embed endpoint)
description: Create a FastAPI app that loads the model from `src/main/resources/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` and exposes `/embed` POST to return embeddings.

title: Add Java client snippet
description: Add a Java example using `HttpClient` showing how to call the shim and parse float[][] vectors.

title: Add embedding usage README
description: Document flatten step, how to run FastAPI shim, and Java client usage in `docs/EMBEDDING_README.md`.
